stem: Katy wants to create a more effective thesis statement for her paper. Which of the following could replace sentence 4 and more accurately convey the thesis of this paper?

options.label: A
options.text: Fearing life in the city, they chose a more rural existence in a big yellow school bus.

options.label: B
options.text: This couple didn’t have to, but they decided that a bus is what they wanted to have.

options.label: C
options.text: This young couple lives in a uniquely converted school bus that they have affectionately named Rosie.

options.label: D
options.text: Instead of a normal dwelling, they have chosen a vehicle—something quite rare, strange, and out of the norm.
